Metadata.title: Dictus — Voice typing, local by default
Metadata.description: Dictate messages, notes and emails on iPhone, Mac, Windows and Linux. Local transcription by default and open source. Desktop is free.
Metadata.jsonld_description: Voice typing with local transcription by default and open source code, for iPhone and desktop.
Metadata.desktop_jsonld_description: Free voice dictation app with local-by-default transcription for macOS, Windows and Linux.

Hero.headline: Your voice stays yours.

Features.title: When the words come, say them.
Features.intro: A message to send, an idea to keep, an email to write. Speak, then read through and make it yours.
Features.messages_desc: Say what you want to write, without losing the thread of the conversation.
Features.notes_desc: Get your first thoughts into a note while they are still fresh.
Features.emails_desc: Speak your reply, then take a moment to read it before sending.

HowItWorks.step1_desc: On iPhone, open the Dictus keyboard. On desktop, use your dictation shortcut.
HowItWorks.step2_desc: The model installed on your device turns your voice into text, locally.
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Your text appears in your app. Review, edit and send when you are ready.
HowItWorks.privacy_desc: Transcription is local by default. Your device processes your voice without having to send it to a remote transcription service.
HowItWorks.privacy_accent: You need a connection to install the app and download a model. Local transcription can then work offline.

OpenSource.title: Trust you can check.
OpenSource.desc: Dictus code is public. You can examine how your voice is processed, follow changes and contribute to the project. Open to inspection, without having to take our word for it.

Privacy.meta_description: How Dictus processes your voice locally and protects your data. Privacy policy for the app and website.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: On iOS, your voice and transcribed text stay on your device. On Desktop, audio transcription is also local. Optional post-processing, disabled by default, may send transcribed text to a provider you explicitly choose.
Privacy.scope: This policy covers the Dictus apps for iOS and Desktop, and the getdictus.com website.
Privacy.data_collection_text: The Dictus apps do not require a Dictus account and include no telemetry or analytics tools. The website uses no advertising cookies or analytics tools. If you choose to donate, the payment provider processes the data needed for that transaction.
Privacy.full_access_text: On iOS, Full Access permission is needed for the dictation keyboard to work. Your voice and transcribed text are processed on your device.
Privacy.data_usage_text: Your voice is used to produce a transcription on your device. On Desktop, post-processing is disabled by default. If you enable it and choose a remote provider, the transcribed text and associated instructions are sent to that provider for the processing you request.
Privacy.third_party_text: Downloading models and checking for updates require network connections. On Desktop, a remote post-processing provider is used only after your explicit choice. Apple processes iOS in-app purchases through the App Store. When you donate, Stripe or BTCPay processes payment data. These services apply their own terms and policies, and Dictus does not receive your card credentials.
Privacy.data_retention_text: Preferences and model files are stored locally on your device. Data sent to a post-processing provider you have chosen, to Apple for an iOS purchase, or to a payment provider for a donation is subject to that service’s retention policies.
Privacy.user_rights_text: You retain control of the data stored locally on your device. For data processed by a post-processing or payment provider, consult its policy and contact that service. For questions about Dictus, contact us at the address below.
Privacy.children_text: The same principles of local processing and no telemetry apply to all users of the Dictus apps, including children.
Privacy.security_text: Speech recognition runs on your device. On Desktop, model downloads and update checks do not send audio or transcribed text. Sending text for remote post-processing requires you to enable it and choose a provider. The Desktop documentation details possible connections and their settings.
Privacy.changes_text: Updates will be posted on this page with a revised date.

Terms.service_text: Dictus is a voice dictation keyboard that transcribes your voice into text entirely on your device, with no internet connection. Voice transcription, fully on-device privacy, and third-party keyboard functionality are provided free of charge. Certain advanced features are offered through the paid Dictus Pro offerings.

The app’s code is open source and governed by its public license available on GitHub. You agree not to use the app for any unlawful purpose or in a way that infringes the rights of others.
Terms.subscription_text: Dictus Pro is offered as an auto-renewable subscription, on a monthly (€4.99) or yearly (€39.99, with a 7-day free trial) plan. A one-time purchase is also offered, described in the next section. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews for the same period unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time in your Apple ID account settings after purchase. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; the period already paid for is not refunded.
Terms.trial_text: The Dictus Pro subscription may include a 7-day free trial. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the paid subscription starts automatically and your Apple ID account is charged. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a paid subscription.
Terms.lifetime_text: Dictus Pro is also offered as a single one-time purchase. It is not a subscription: it does not renew, it is never charged again, and it carries no free trial. The applicable price is the one shown in the App Store at the time of purchase. The purchase is tied to your Apple ID account and can be restored across your devices using the restore purchases function. The lifetime purchase covers every current and future Pro feature that runs on your device or on a server you provide. Any feature relying on Dictus infrastructure is a separate offering.
Terms.refunds_text: All payments, subscriptions, and one-time purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store. Refund requests are subject to Apple’s App Store terms and handled directly by Apple; PIVI Solutions has no access to your payment information and cannot process refunds directly.
